top_signals.title: Chinese state group developing automated attack tool for cyber espionage, Google says
top_signals.summary: Google released its latest AI Threat Tracker report on Monday, writing that threat actors are rapidly evolving their use of artificial intelligence in attacks — now leaning more heavily on autonomous multi-agent offensive frameworks like Artex, CAIRN, CyberStrikeAI and PentAGI to execute multi-stage intrusions at greater operational velocity.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
